children: Indonesia's central bank governor said on Wednesday Bank Indonesia is gradually cutting the reserve requirement ratio by 1 percentage point to 8%, effective November 1, and to 7% from December 1.

The bank is also giving a domestic non-deliverable forward incentive through a further discount and is strengthening rupiah stabilisation measures by optimising foreign exchange interventions, the governor added.
